header.title: How does Kasoa.pl work?
header.description: Find answers to the most frequently asked questions regarding buying, selling, and our secure escrow protection system.

process.question: How do I buy unique items on Kasoa.pl?
process.answer: Select the item you are interested in from the catalog and add it to your shopping cart. Since we offer unique 1-of-1 items, the product will be temporarily reserved for you. Then proceed to checkout, fill in your delivery address, and complete the transaction securely with your card via Stripe.

escrow.question: How is my money protected during a purchase?
escrow.answer: Kasoa.pl utilizes an advanced Escrow protection system. After making a payment, your funds are securely held in an independent, frozen technical account. The seller will not receive the payout until the package is delivered and you manually confirm receipt in your dashboard.

shipping.question: What do I need to receive a package from a seller?
shipping.answer: During checkout, you only need to provide your fulfillment delivery address. The seller will ship the package to that specific address using our platform fulfillment guidelines. Once the parcel is in transit, you will receive an email update containing a unique verification tracking link.

listing.question: How can I list a product for sale?
listing.answer: Log into your account, click 'Sell an Item', and fill out the listing form. Upload bright, clear images of your item, accurately select its current product condition, choose a category, and specify the net payout amount you want to earn from the sale.

pricing.question: Do you charge any fees for listing items in the catalog?
pricing.answer: Listing items is 100% free. You declare your desired payout amount 'X', and any platform operational commissions or transaction handling fees are dynamically appended on the buyer's side during checkout.

payout.question: When will the funds reach my active Payout balance?
payout.answer: After shipping the package, log into your account dashboard, navigate to 'Shipments', and enter the tracking number right away. The funds will automatically be released and credited to your Payout balance as soon as the buyer clicks the confirmation link.
